# Autocomplete labels include context while inserted values remain addresses or group names

The port moves extra address-book/server text into getLabelAt and makes getCommentAt empty for local address books, LDAP and news. getValueAt and getFinalCompleteValueAt still return the unadorned value. Preserve this display-versus-completion boundary when modifying providers; suffix text must not become part of a recipient address or newsgroup value. No autocomplete popup, keyboard completion or provider connection ran. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: autocomplete result contract.
